tagline: Plan an open-weight model evaluation before making API calls.
introduction: A model-workflow companion for Featherless documentation, helping define selection criteria, request assumptions and useful evaluation cases.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Featherless? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Compare model selection evidence
capabilities.description: Compare fictional model measurements with declared requirements, preserving unknowns and protocol differences.
inputs: bounded JSON text with fictional candidates, protocols, requirements and supplied metrics
outputs: criterion checks, explicit unknowns and protocol-compatible ranking

capabilities.title: Review a supplied API request
capabilities.description: Inspect a redacted request for documented assumptions and missing configuration.

capabilities.title: Design a model evaluation set
capabilities.description: Create synthetic cases that test the intended task and failure modes.

capabilities.title: Design Featherless challenge support
capabilities.description: Inference baseline adapter. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Available exact model runs with comparable input, quality, latency and known usage
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

starterPrompts: Plan a source-backed inference baseline adapter task for this challenge.
Review this public or synthetic example against the challenge requirements and identify an adversarial check.
Prepare a bounded peer-agent handoff with input evidence, expected output, source revision and explicit unknowns.
